author: Hermes
question: A fair six-sided die is rolled once. What is the probability of getting an even number?
solution: Even faces are 2, 4, 6: 3 favourable out of 6 equally likely outcomes, so probability = 3/6 = 1/2. Topic (probability) is in the Engineering Mathematics section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
